name: RTP / Media Diagnosis
description: Diagnose one-way audio, a drop at answer, or a codec mismatch from media evidence.

permissionsRequired.reason: Read logs for a process this run already started.
Read the file the change or diagnosis depends on.
Run a command the project files or the host evidence justify.
Run a command on a configured server alias.

validation.rule: The media path, codec, or answer-time failure was cited from a log or capture. Signaling was not assumed to be the media fault.
